canDoYue: 你識話要寄包裹、填表申報，仲識問幾多日同追蹤編號。
canDoEn: Send a parcel, fill in the form, and ask about days and tracking.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I would like to send this small parcel by airmail.
dialogue.glossYue: 我想用空郵寄呢個細包裹。
dialogue.say: I would like to send this small parcel by airmail.

dialogue.speaker: cole
dialogue.text: Please fill in the customs form and declare every item.
dialogue.glossYue: 請填報關表，並且申報每件物品。
dialogue.say: Please fill in the customs form and declare every item.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: How long will this small parcel take to reach the destination?
dialogue.glossYue: 呢個細包裹要幾耐先到目的地？
dialogue.say: How long will this small parcel take to reach the destination?

dialogue.speaker: cole
dialogue.text: It will take five days, and we need your signature here.
dialogue.glossYue: 要五日，我哋需要你喺呢度簽名。
dialogue.say: It will take five days, and we need your signature here.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: This parcel is fragile, so please mark it as fragile.
dialogue.glossYue: 呢個包裹易碎，請註明易碎。
dialogue.say: This parcel is fragile, so please mark it as fragile.

dialogue.speaker: cole
dialogue.text: Please mark the full weight on the form before we send it.
dialogue.glossYue: 寄出之前請喺表格寫明全部重量。
dialogue.say: Please mark the full weight on the form before we send it.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: May I keep this receipt until the parcel reaches my home?
dialogue.glossYue: 包裹送到我家之前，我可唔可以留住收據？
dialogue.say: May I keep this receipt until the parcel reaches my home?

dialogue.speaker: cole
dialogue.text: Your tracking number is on the receipt, so please add one postage stamp.
dialogue.glossYue: 追蹤號碼喺收據上面，請貼一張郵票。
dialogue.say: Your tracking number is on the receipt, so please add one postage stamp.

choices: 我想用空郵寄呢個細包裹
understand.explain: parcel 係包裹。airmail 係空郵。

understand.prompt: How long will this small parcel take to reach the destination? 即係問緊咩？
understand.explain: how long 係問要幾耐。destination 係目的地。

understand.prompt: This parcel is fragile, so please mark it as fragile. 呢句即係點？
choices: 呢個包裹易碎，請註明易碎

sound.title: weight 同 stamp
sound.note: weight 同 airmail 嘅 mail 有 /eɪ/。stamp 同 fragile 有 /æ/，嘴張大。兩個都唔好讀成粵語嘅「衣」。
